description: This file defines the SizeSelectorPanel class, a Swing UI component representing a grid-based size selector panel with selectable elements, supporting mouse interactions to select different sizes.

classes.name: SizeSelectorPanel
classes.description: A JPanel subclass providing a grid-based size selection UI component.

classes.name: SizeSelectorPanel.Element
classes.description: An inner class representing individual selectable grid elements within the SizeSelectorPanel.

methods.name: SizeSelectorPanel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel with a grid layout, creates elements, and sets up mouse listeners for selection.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Overrides paint method to visually represent each grid element, indicating selection with color.
